notes:
A RETIREMENT, NOT AN ADJUDICATION. row_count is 0 on purpose: this batch adds no row and records 139 being retired from the CERT C oracle. No verdict is changed anywhere.

WHY. FIO50-C and FIO51-C are not CERT C identifiers (they correspond to CERT C++'s FIO50-CPP and FIO51-CPP). aurora-lint 9aace3a3 removed both rules. The oracle is a CERT C oracle, so labels on these ids are retired, not deleted.

WHAT. Every label under the two ids: FIO50-C 128 and FIO51-C 11, all FP. Selected by rule id as a census; nothing was re-read and nothing was judged.

THE 10 SAME-LINE ROWS NEED NO NEW JUDGEMENT. For 10 of these rows the covering CERT C rule reports the same line at aurora-lint 9aace3a3: FIO39-C at sqlite ext/misc/base85.c:434, and FIO42-C at hostap src/eap_peer/eap_fast_pac.c:276, lua liolib.c:262 and :275, mbedtls library/psa_its_file.c:84, pureftpd puredb/src/puredb_write.c:64 and :65, and sqlite ext/misc/csv.c:136, ext/misc/tmstmpvfs.c:498 and ext/misc/vfslog.c:296. This was re-derived rather than taken from the task: release build of aurora-lint c731d24b (which contains 9aace3a3), run with --rules FIO39-C,FIO42-C over each corpus at its pinned commit, matched on (file, line) against every FIO50-C/FIO51-C row; exactly these 10 matched. Each of the 10 covering keys already carries its own label in this repo (all FP), so the old rows duplicate a line that is already adjudicated under a CERT C rule and are retired with the rest, as in the correction-unresolvable-path-hostap-task1388 precedent. The other 129 lines are not reported by either rule.

HISTORICAL RECORDS LEFT AS THEY ARE. The source manifests' rules lists still name FIO50-C/FIO51-C, and tests/golden/run-269 still contains them. Both record what was true when written: a manifest's declared fields stay as submitted apart from row_count and superseded_rows (README), and the run-269 goldens score labels read at a pinned past commit, so they are unaffected by this batch.

ARCHIVED, NOT LOST. The rows are removed from data/*/adjudication.csv but stay complete in this repo's history at the parent commit, and each source manifest names every removed key under superseded_rows. Postgres keeps them until benchmarking_db's drop_ground_truth_rows.py --keys runs, since the mainline sync never deletes; that step writes the full rows to oracle_corrections/.
